instruction: Convert the current webpage to PDF in landscape orientation and save it to the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to save webpage as PDF in landscape orientation to Desktop. Evaluator checks if the saved PDF file exists, has landscape orientation (width > height), and has at least 1 page. The getter extracts PDF properties (orientation, dimensions, page count) and the metric verifies orientation matches 'landscape'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts PDF properties from the specified Desktop file path using pypdf library
Orientation detection logic is correct: width > height determines landscape orientation
Metric properly handles expected parameter (rules dict passed directly by get_rule function)
Complete coverage: verifies file existence, landscape orientation, and minimum page count
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts orientation/page_count, metric compares against expected rules
Partial credit scoring logic is appropriate for multi-check verification
Edge case handling: returns 0.0 if file doesn't exist or cannot be read
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The evaluator assumes a specific filename based on webpage title. If filename differs, verification will fail. This is acceptable for deterministic OSWorld tasks but could be made more robust by searching Desktop for any PDF files matching criteria.
